commit.message: refactor: simplify total calculation and add format helpers

proposal.root_cause: The recent refactor mistakenly omitted tax from the total calculation in src/pricing.js, setting totalCents to taxableCents only.
proposal.explanation: Tests expect the total amount to include tax. By removing the tax addition, the computed total is lower, causing the Playwright assertion to fail. Restoring the original calculation (taxableCents + taxCents) fixes the discrepancy.
proposal.pr_title: Fix total calculation to include tax
proposal.pr_summary: Reintroduce tax addition in totalCents calculation within src/pricing.js to ensure totals match expected values in tests.
